ModDescription: Choose which features to use. Changes affect new actions; rolls already in progress finish unchanged. All features work without MCM.

Settings.Name: Best-in-party lockpick
Settings.Description:
Use the best eligible party member's modifiers for lockpicking. When disabled, the character attempting the lockpick uses their own modifiers.

In multiplayer, the host's choice applies to everyone.

Settings.Name: Best-in-party disarm
Settings.Description:
Use the best eligible party member's modifiers for disarming traps. When disabled, the character attempting the disarm uses their own modifiers.

In multiplayer, the host's choice applies to everyone.
